import pandas as pd
import csv

# Read the input file
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t02_eurostat_raw.csv')

# Pivot the data from long to wide format
# Index by city_id, city_name, year
# Columns by indicator_id
# Values from 'value' column

pivot_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year', 'indicator_id', 'value']]

# Pivot to wide format
wide_df = pivot_df.pivot_table(
    index=['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'],
    columns='indicator_id',
    values='value',
    aggfunc='first'
)

# Reset index to make city_id, city_name, year regular columns
wide_df = wide_df.reset_index()

# Sort columns to have identifier columns first, then indicator columns
identifier_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
indicator_cols = [col for col in wide_df.columns if col not in identifier_cols]
wide_df = wide_df[identifier_cols + indicator_cols]

# Convert NaN to empty strings for proper CSV output
wide_df = wide_df.fillna('')

# Write to CSV with proper RFC 4180 compliance
wide_df.to_csv(
    'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv',
    index=False,
    quoting=csv.QUOTE_ALL
)

print(f"Created outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv with {len(wide_df)} rows")
